虚拟手柄后端已保存，下次开始映射时生效: Gamepad backend saved; it takes effect the next time mapping starts
使用与摇杆鼠标、方向映射及虚拟摇杆相同的输入死区。完整校准位于「游戏配置 → 摇: Shares the input deadzone with stick mouse, direction mappings and virtual sticks. Full calibration is under Game profiles → Stick settings. The flick threshold uses processed stick travel.
左右摇杆分别设置。摇杆鼠标、Flick／配套瞄准、方向映射和虚拟摇杆共用这里的输: Set each stick independently. Stick mouse, Flick and companion aim, direction mappings and virtual sticks share this processing without adding separate deadzones.
先修正中心与行程，再处理死区、防回弹和扳机。保存后应用；修改输入死区也会影响内外: Center and travel calibration comes before deadzone, rebound and trigger processing. Save to apply. Input deadzones also affect inner/outer rings and button activation positions.

。左列为原始杆位，右列为应用校准和输入处理后的杆位。: . Raw input is on the left; calibrated and processed input is on the right.
开始观察或映射后，可对照原始输入和处理后的输入。: Start observing or mapping to compare raw and processed input.
中心偏移使用右为正、上为正的坐标；扳机原始范围为 0–1。校准会影响该配置的所有: Center offsets use right-positive and up-positive coordinates; raw trigger travel is 0–1. Calibration affects all mappings in this profile. Recording and UI navigation keep raw input.
数字扳机在校准后的行程上判断，达到阈值输出满扳机；回差与松开防抖过滤边界抖动，最: Digital triggers use calibrated travel and output full deflection at the threshold. Hysteresis and release debounce filter boundary jitter; the minimum debounce follows the native setting.
圆周校准需要 72 个 0.05–20 的有限倍率。: Radial calibration requires 72 finite multipliers between 0.05 and 20.
每个摇杆使用 72 个方向倍率，依次对应每 5° 的圆周采样。全为 1 表示不修: Each stick uses 72 directional multipliers, sampled every 5°. All ones leave the radial response unchanged. Paste an existing calibration array to import it.
组合键、双向滚轮、鼠标侧键和体感鼠标使用键鼠后端。虚拟手柄可单独选择 FlexI: Chords, both scroll directions, side buttons and gyro mouse use the keyboard/mouse backend. Virtual gamepads can use a separate native FlexInput output implementation.
ViGEm 提供标准 Xbox／DS4 虚拟手柄，需安装 ViGEmBus。可以: ViGEm creates standard virtual Xbox/DS4 controllers and requires ViGEmBus. HIDMaestro keyboard/mouse output can run alongside it.
FlexInput 原生 ViGEm 手柄后端需要此驱动，可与 HIDMaest: Required by FlexInput's native ViGEm gamepad backend. It can run alongside HIDMaestro keyboard/mouse output.
体感鼠标与动作键鼠使用键鼠后端，手柄按键和摇杆使用虚拟手柄后端。两种后端的创建和: Gyro mouse and keyboard/mouse actions use the keyboard/mouse backend. Controller buttons and sticks use the gamepad backend. Both are created and released with the same mapping session.
本设备的 XInput 接口已通过就绪检查；HIDMaestro 未提供玩家槽位: This device's XInput interface passed the readiness check. HIDMaestro does not expose a player-slot query.
正在录入，输出暂时释放；虚拟设备和隐藏会话保持连接。: Recording: outputs are temporarily released; the virtual device and hiding session remain connected.
选择 Xbox／DualShock 4、保存配置并开始映射后，这里显示实际创建结: Choose Xbox or DualShock 4, save the profile and start mapping to see the actual creation result here. Observing input does not create a virtual gamepad.
HIDMaestro Xbox 使用 XInput 伴随接口，传统游戏控制器窗口: HIDMaestro Xbox uses an XInput companion interface and may be absent from the traditional controller panel. Use the runtime status above to check whether output was created.
部分游戏只读取第一个 XInput 玩家槽位。若显示第 2–4 槽位，请先停止映: Some games only read the first XInput player slot. For slots 2–4, stop mapping, disconnect other XInput controllers and start again.
摇杆输入死区必须在 0–0.95 之间（不含 0.95）: Stick input deadzones must be between 0 and 0.95, excluding 0.95
摇杆中心偏移必须为 -1–1 的有限数值: Stick center offsets must be finite values between -1 and 1
摇杆圆周校准需要 72 个 0.05–20 的有限倍率: Stick radial calibration requires 72 finite multipliers between 0.05 and 20
扳机校准范围必须在 0–1 之内，最大值需至少高出最小值 0.01: Trigger calibration must stay within 0–1 and have a span of at least 0.01
扳机数字阈值必须在 0–1 之间: Trigger digital thresholds must be between 0 and 1
扳机回差必须在 0–0.5 之间: Trigger hysteresis must be between 0 and 0.5
扳机松开防抖时间必须在 4–5000 毫秒之间: Trigger release debounce must be between 4 and 5000 ms
